_schema.description: Golden fixture for the Chrome-extension JS EV combine, computed by the R reference (bestballBroSim R/ev_blocks.R). Self-contained: validate the JS pipeline offline against `expected` using only `inputs`.
_schema.combine_formula: dollars(path) = g1(R1) * ( (1-g2(R2))*payout_qf(R2) + g2(R2)*(1-g3(R3))*payout_sf(R3) + g2(R2)*g3(R3)*h_final(R4) ); roster_ev = mean over paths. marginal_ev(cand) = EV(roster+cand) - EV(roster), same paths (CRN).

draws.layout: flat C-order array; value index = ((path*n_players)+player)*n_weeks + week (all 0-based)
draws.player_index: appearance_id -> 0-based player index; weeks[k] = NFL week for week-index k

_schema.curves: each curve is an {x,y} grid; evaluate by linear interpolation clamped at the ends (R approx rule=2)
_schema.round_scores: per path, R[r] = sum over stage_weeks[r] of the best-ball optimal weekly lineup total (FLEX = best overflow of RB/WR/TE per lineup_spec)
_schema.uncovered: candidate ids NOT in draws.player_index are uncovered: exclude from ranking and flag (the reference would abort if asked to score one) -- see expected.uncovered_candidates
_schema.tolerance: doubles; assert |js - r| <= 1e-6 absolute for scores, <= 1e-6 relative for EV/marginals
